title: Interview with Larry Summers, Former Secretary of the Treasury | The Problem with Jon Stewart
summary: A short excerpt of Jon Stewart interviewing former Treasury Secretary Larry Summers about the causes of inflation and whether workers or corporate profits are to blame. It comes from an episode of The Problem With Jon Stewart.
why: HN commenters link it in threads on greedflation and corporate pricing power as an accessible exchange of opposing views.

quote.text: It's a real good exchange of viewpoints on the matter -- better than you'd get with most other commentary.
